faq.a: Sevinj is associated with the Turkic form سَفِينْج, whose core sense is sevinj; joy (azerbaijani form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Sevinj?
faq.a: Sevinj is associated with Turkic. Sevinj is the Azerbaijani form of Turkic sevinç, meaning 'joy'.
No — the underlying form is Turkic, not Arabic.
Sevinj can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Turkic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Sevinj should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Sevinc is a Turkic word, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Sevinj mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Sevinj is rendered سوینج and carries the sense سوینج، خوشی.

faq.q: What does Sevinj mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Sevinj is rendered سوینج and carries the sense سوینج، شادی.
A romanized syllable approximation is se-vinj. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Sevinj?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Sevinj, sevinj. Script forms are سوينج, سوینج, سَفِينْج, सेविंज.

faq.q: Is Sevinj a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
